summary: Tisha Varma is a final-year B.E. Information Technology student (graduating June 2027) at L.D. College of Engineering, Ahmedabad. She works as a backend and full-stack Python engineer with applied-AI experience in LLMs, RAG and agentic systems. She takes ideas from a problem statement to a working product: the AI layer, backend architecture, APIs, database, authentication, deployment and a usable interface. She has three internships, an INCF open-source contribution, a founder role at HerDefenders, and 2nd place at HackSprint 2026.

known_gaps: RazorFlow AI has no user authentication. [src 6.1]
RazorFlow AI session state is held in memory, so only one server process can run. [src 6.1]
RazorFlow AI LLM calls are blocking. [src 6.1]
RazorFlow AI runs Razorpay in test mode. [src 6.1]
The RazorFlow AI audit chain is tamper-evident rather than unbreakable: timestamps and reason text are not hashed, there is no secret key, and concurrent writes can fork it. [src 6.1]
The RazorFlow AI "without AI" revenue figure is derived by subtracting upsell items, not from a controlled experiment. [src 6.1]
PharmaMate asks the user to paste the Gemini API key into main.py. [src 6.4]
Workchain contracts are for local demos and need an audit before mainnet use. [src 6.6]
MySQL and PostgreSQL were used only on a few small past projects. [src 7]
HerDefenders is not active, and the code is not public. [src 5.5, 6.7]
Amazon recommender: optimistic rating bias, cold start, a limited item pool, and approximate explanations for SVD and NMF. [src 6.3]
